outcome: Association between ultrasound signs and intraoperative features with urologic injuries
cohort: Singleton pregnancies with a history of at least one prior CD and diagnosed prenatally with an anterior low-lying placenta or placenta previa at 32-36 weeks' gestation
finding: Preoperative ultrasound examination, particularly LUS remodeling on transabdominal ultrasound, is useful in evaluating the risk of intraoperative bladder injury in patients with prior CD and low-lying placenta or placenta previa.
